definition: every decode is false: nothing was transmitted

definitions.duplicates_dropped: decodes of an already-decoded payload that the receiver itself discarded (PassStats::duplicates)
definitions.duplicates_emitted: the same payload reported more than once in the output (must be 0)
definitions.false_decode: a CRC-valid decode whose payload was not transmitted in that slot
definitions.ground_truth: the harness knows the transmitted payloads; the receiver is given only the 27 s window
definitions.latency: wall-clock time of decode_slot per slot, measured while other slots were decoded concurrently on the same pool; indicative only (see `z30 --benchmark perf` for controlled latency)
definitions.snr: SPEC.md section 10: frame signal power over the noise power in 2500 Hz; real white Gaussian noise, sigma = 1 per sample at 6 kHz, so SNR = P / (5000 / 6000)
definitions.success: a decode whose 63 payload bits equal the transmitted payload

exploratory: fewer than 400 per point (this benchmark's publishable size): exploratory, not publishable
frames_policy: a sensitivity crossing needs at least 200 frames per point (AGENTS.md section 5); a benchmark below its publishable size is exploratory
interferer_levels: SNR per interferer in 2500 Hz as for a z-30 frame: CW carriers uniform -10..+20 dB; random 16-FSK -3 dB each (labelled 0 dB before 2026-09-28, audit DSP-07: the signal was always -3 dB); FT8-like 0 dB each; impulses up to 40 sigma
not_tested: real recorded non-z-30 audio (speech, music, real FT8/RTTY, real QRN): no recordings exist yet
not_the_published_run: status exploratory: 20 per point, below the publishable 400

points.label: 8 random 16-FSK signals without the Costas pattern, -3 dB each

power.note: 0 false decodes in 100 slots bounds the per-slot rate below 2.95e-2 (95%, one-sided), i.e. 85.0 per day of continuous monitoring (2880 slots). A true rate a third of that bound still gives zero in 100 slots with probability 37%, so this run cannot tell such a receiver from a perfect one; a change that affects acceptance needs its own, larger, pre-registered false-decode run
